paper_type_rationale: 论文提出针对自回归视频扩散训练图的 SGF 方法，并通过 5 秒、60 秒和 240 秒实验验证长视频外推。
dominant_domain: autoregressive video diffusion and long-horizon generation
must_cover: 恢复精度与 sink 消融
key_numbers: GSB 超过 1900 个 paired judgments
real_comparisons: Self Forcing vs SGF under matched TF initialization
Self Forcing vs SGF under causal CD initialization
Self Forcing vs SGF under causal ODE initialization
frozen cache vs direct differentiable cache vs SGF

central_claims.claim: SGF restores future-loss supervision through clean-context KV writing without full serial rollout BPTT.
central_claims.what_it_actually_proves: The implemented bounded reconstruction path is trainable and carries context-KV gradients.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not recover the exact gradient of the full serial rollout.

central_claims.claim: SGF improves native long-video extrapolation relative to matched Self Forcing.
central_claims.what_it_actually_proves: Under the reported prompts, seeds, initializations and context policies, most consistency-oriented metrics and human preference favor SGF.
central_claims.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not establish universal gains across models, datasets, horizons or metrics; dynamic degree is often lower.

claim_boundaries: not a new long-context memory capacity
not evidence that every VBench metric improves
not a proof of generalization beyond the reported causal DiT/VAE setup
negative_or_limiting_results: Self Forcing has higher dynamic degree in several rows
TF motion is slightly higher for Self Forcing at 60 seconds
direct differentiable historical cache runs OOM
Pass-2 only approximates serial forward up to mixed-precision error
sink 8 has marginal gains but consumes context budget
mechanism_result_map: Detached historical KV causes missing writer supervision -> SGF opens gradient through recomputed clean-context KV -> subject/background/flickering and motion smoothness improve.
Serial graph retention is infeasible -> no-gradient Pass 1 plus parallel Pass 2 keeps bounded memory -> 87.01 GB peak and 11.71 s per 5 steps.
Pass-2 geometry matches Pass 1 -> cosine 0.999886 and relative L2 0.01409 -> local reconstruction is a credible surrogate, not full BPTT.
Wan VAE boundary lasts several latent positions -> sink 4 captures transition region -> sink 4 is used for frame-wise streaming.
comparative_positioning: Self Forcing addresses exposure bias but freezes historical memory writing
Causal Forcing addresses causal initialization mismatch
retrieval, sparse attention and KV compression change available memory and are orthogonal
Video-Mirai and Next Forcing extend future-aware supervision at a different level
reuse_takeaways: Audit whether future loss trains memory formation or only memory reading
Use stop-gradient rollout records plus parallel replay when full BPTT is infeasible
Match replay mask, RoPE, sink, FIFO and timestep exactly to inference
Separate long-horizon consistency metrics from apparent motion metrics
followup_questions: How does sampled exit-step distribution affect gains?
Does SGF transfer across VAE temporal grouping and causal DiT architectures?
What is the marginal benefit when combined with retrieval or KV compression?
Can evaluator confidence intervals and catastrophic drift rates be reported?
Which gradient path improves identity versus camera geometry versus action continuity?

section_plan.focus: 固定元数据与资源来源，明确 arXiv 身份、作者、机构、项目页和评测资源。
忠实翻译摘要中的问题、双阶段机制、长视频结果和发布信息，不加入后见之明判断。
区分 historical context-gradient gap、双阶段 replay、梯度边界和跨 horizon 实验贡献。
用一句话界定 SGF 恢复的具体记忆写入梯度及其没有恢复的 full rollout 梯度。
说明 exposure bias 已由 Self Forcing 部分处理，而 frozen historical KV 仍阻断 future loss 对 clean-context writer 的监督。
记录 5 秒训练窗、60/240 秒外推、VBench/VBench-Long/MovieGen prompts、frame/chunk 配置和匹配基线协议。
重建 Pass 1 无梯度串行 rollout、Pass 2 并行上下文重算、梯度边界、复杂度比较和 sink-plus-FIFO policy。
用表格呈现 frame-wise 60/240 秒指标，解释 dynamic degree 反例，报告 GSB、训练成本、恢复精度和 sink 消融。
解释为何 memory-writing gradient 对身份和布局漂移有效，区分已证明与未证明的边界，并给出复现风险。
列出非 full BPTT、replay geometry 对齐、上下文容量、评测覆盖、统计细节与工程成本限制。
将 SGF 定位为训练信号层的 memory-formation 修复，并提出梯度位置、exit step、跨 VAE、组合方法和严格人评实验。
给出论文的 arXiv 引用，并保留论文项目页以便后续核对代码和模型发布。
